messages:
maria: Heads-up — I pushed a prototype for an allocation-snapshot + compact-scheduler. Want quick feedback on safety/perf tradeoffs.

alex: Nice. Can you summarize the invariants? We can't afford long global pauses.

maria: Plan is shallow snapshot of the alloc map (resident pages + owner tenant) -> compute compaction plan off-thread -> apply moves via async migrate ops with small quiesce windows per-tenant. No stop-the-world.

jon: How do we keep the KV cache consistent if pages move while a request reads from GPU memory?

maria: We add epoch stamps on requests. Migration updates mappings and bumps epoch. Readers detect epoch mismatch and fallback to copy-on-read for that microbatch. The fallback should be rare.

sara: Copy-on-read could hurt tail p99. Can we instead drain new microbatches for a tenant for a couple ms while swapping a chunk?

alex: Also need heuristics for chunk size. Bigger chunk => fewer rounds but longer per-tenant quiesce.

maria: Thinking adaptive window: start at 4MB chunk, measure tail (p95/p99). If tail > threshold, shrink to 1MB and be more conservative for that tenant.

jon: Tenant SLA handling: some tenants should be low-aggressiveness or opt-out (e.g., enterprise with strict latency SLAs).

sara: Observability is critical: per-tenant metrics (moved_bytes, pause_ms, epoch_conflicts) plus trace-id correlation so we can see which requests hit fallback.

maria: We'll also expose a dry-run mode that computes and reports plans but doesn't execute. Useful for safety checks.

ci-bot: deploy/pipeline #420 passed — test-suite: compact-scheduler-proto ✅

tomek: Edge case — pinned allocations (params, mmap pinned for CUDA) must be skipped or remapped carefully. If we try to move a pinned page, migration will fail. Need skip-list + metrics on pinned skips.

maria: Agreed. We'll maintain a skip list and a retry policy: if migrate fails, revert mapping and mark page as 'sticky' for X minutes to avoid repeated attempts.

alex: Canary + rollback: rollout on one host with synthetic/production-mirroring traffic. Abort if p95 or correctness tests regress. Add automatic abort threshold.

sara: Can we surface compaction into autoscaler decisions? Example: defer compaction when host memory pressure or thermal events are high.

maria: Yes — compaction respects host signals (mem pressure, oom_score) and our resident target TTL. Also listens to our own signals: 'eviction_active' and 'hotset_busy'.

jon: If eviction is happening, compaction should yield. They can fight for IO/PCIe bandwidth.

maria: Will implement coordinator signals: eviction_active, high_io, hotset_busy -> compaction pauses. Also a per-tenant throttle token-bucket so we can tune aggressiveness.

sara: I'll open a small RFC PR with sequence diagrams and the admin API: `/admin/compact?mode=dryrun|execute|abort&tenant=...` plus metrics.

maria: Thanks — anyone volunteer to review perf harness and KV integration tests? @alex @jon

alex: 👍 I'll take perf harness and help define chunk heuristics.

jon: I'll own KV cache integration tests and the epoch check logic.

maria: Awesome. I'll add the abort thresholds and coord signals. Will post an updated PR with the sequence diagram and a tiny simulation.

sara: Quick note — please add a flag to opt tenants out via tenant metadata instead of static config file. Ops should toggle at runtime.

maria: Good call. Runtime tenant opt-out + admin override.

alex: One more ask: include a small synthetic harness that reproduces hotset churn so we can tune adaptive window without touching prod.

maria: Yep — synthetic harness is in the branch under `tools/compact-harness`. Example run: `./compact-harness --tenants 50 --churn 0.2 --seqdist long-tail`

jon: For the record, we should document the failure modes: failed migrate -> sticky page -> increased fragmentation. Need cleanup job to revisit sticky pages after X mins.

maria: Added to TODO. Thanks all — I'll post PR link when ready.

sara: :thumbsup:

alex: 👍

ci-bot: Note: remember to add unit tests for epoch bump visibility and the abort circuit.
